purpose: Absences that are architecturally CORRECT, each with the readback or verifier line that proves it. Without this file the audit re-reports the same disproven scares every run; two independent sweeps have already reported the Altmer spine trio as a bug. A waiver is a claim that needs evidence, not a mute button: every entry cites where the proof lives. Delete an entry the moment its evidence stops holding.

waivers.reason: Substrate-owned reward. These three manager declarations are vestigial: their only call sites are inside StripAllPdvSpells (PDV__ManagerQuest.psc:17221-17463), a flat teardown list where every call passes shouldBeActive=False, reached only from PrepareForUninstall and RunAuthoriaActorValueRepair. The live grant lane is PDV_Substrate_AltmerAncestor (0715AC:Devotion.esp), whose VMAD binds Substrate_Always/Mid/High to 0715A7/0715A9/0715AB. Binding the manager copies would create a second owner for a substrate-owned record -- the anti-pattern tools/pdv_reward_runtime_order_lint.mjs:398-403 exists to prevent. Breton, Imperial, Nord and Dunmer carry no manager spine properties at all and their spines work.
waivers.evidence: tools/pdv_verify.mjs:6697-6699 asserts substrate ownership; references/authoring/PDV_HO_1.0.4_Scope_DrHeisenPatch_2026-07-25.md:170-197 records the same false finding and its correction.

waivers.reason: Runtime switchboard output. OriginRuntime is deliberately assigned in code from PDV_FLST_OriginAdapters after PDV_GLO_OriginRace becomes valid, then rebound whenever the captured origin changes. A static VMAD binding would pin one race adapter and defeat the switchboard.
waivers.evidence: PDV__ManagerQuest.psc:739-745 declares the runtime-filled property and adapter FormList; ResolveOriginRuntime at :855-886 selects list[raceIndex], assigns OriginRuntime, and tracks _boundOriginRace. Direct houseCARL readback 2026-08-20 confirms the ten adapter quests 071794-07179D and PDV_FLST_OriginAdapters 07179E are present; validate_scripts reports OriginRuntime absent as designed.

waivers.reason: Runtime switchboard mirror. DEBUG must target the same race adapter currently selected by the manager, so ResolveOriginRuntime assigns DebugRuntime.OriginRuntime whenever it binds or rebinds the manager output. A static VMAD binding would make debug behavior disagree with the player's captured origin.
waivers.evidence: PDV__ManagerQuest.psc:848-882 validates the race-indexed adapter, assigns OriginRuntime, then assigns DebugRuntime.OriginRuntime from the same picked reference. OnInit and OnUpdate call ResolveOriginRuntime so delayed capture and later origin changes reconcile the mirror.

waivers.reason: Native-pair omission. The race-response message is the 'you consorted with a Daedra' reaction, which does not apply to a race that worships this Prince natively. PDV_Deity_Azura (071078:Devotion.esp) carries Stance_Dunmer=0 (STANCE_NATIVE) and DeityName='Azurah'; that relationship is handled by the Deity lane, not the Daedric path lane.

Legacy-generation activators (Dunmer portable shrine, Dunmer private shrine, Hircine hunt rite) whose routes do not consume the unbound properties. SignalValue is passed only by ROUTE_KHAJIIT_MOON_OBSERVANCE and ROUTE_KHAJIIT_ROAD_HOME (PDV_EventSignalActivator.psc:144,146); these three dispatch through RouteDunmerPortableShrinePrayer / RouteDunmerPlayerHomeBonus / RouteHircineHuntRite, which take no argument. SignalSourceId falls back to TraceLabel then 'activator_route_<RouteId>' (:256-266), and PlayerREF falls back to Game.GetPlayer() (:268-274).
waivers.evidence: PDV_EventSignalActivator.psc:139-157 route dispatch; :256-274 fallbacks. Live readback 2026-08-06.

Retired-compatibility records, deliberately never granted on the Aedric thin-shell deities. A patron's blessing begins at Devoted; there is no patron Seeker tier. The SPEL records are kept so old saves do not break, and PDV_DeityBase's boon code is kept as a now-no-op. The exclusion matters: PDV_DaedricPathBase overrides SyncPatronBoonsToTier and grants Boon_* for real (PDV_DaedricPathBase.psc:115-153), so all 16 Prince paths DO bind them and must keep being audited.
waivers.evidence: PDV_Architecture_v3.md ADR-0005 ('focused T1 records remain save-compatible artifacts but are never granted'); enforcement comment at PDV_DeityBase.psc:410; owner ruling 2026-07-14 in references/authoring/PDV_RaceGuide_NexusFinalPass_2026-07-14.md:91-95, which states verbatim: 'A future audit that flags these as "unreachable, wire them" is wrong.' See also references/authoring/PDV_PlayerStateBugs_2026-07-14.md:148 and handoff/PDV_CleanupDebt_Handoff_2026-06-17.md:48-58.

waivers.reason: Opt-in per-deity hooks, not a per-deity requirement. Each is absent on the overwhelming majority of the 49-member deity/path population and every read is null-guarded: a deity only carries a ReputationTrack, StateTrack or authored rivalry when its design calls for one. Reporting the absent majority inverts signal and noise.
waivers.evidence: Detector A family split at time of waiver: present on 1-3 of 49 members.

waivers.reason: Optional skeleton-track arrays are now null-guarded at every dereference. Current production race logic uses the manager-owned StorageUtil tracks; unbound skeleton arrays therefore fall through without a Papyrus error and cannot be mistaken for live race-state authority.
waivers.evidence: PDV_ReputationTrack.psc GetStateLabelAt, IsExtremeStateIndex, GetLowestExtremeStateIndex, GetHighestExtremeStateIndex, and ComputeStateIndexForValue all guard the relevant array before .Length.

waivers.reason: StateLabels is optional on dormant skeleton tracks and the only dereference is now null-guarded, returning the established Unset fallback.

These generation-two state quests deliberately use the script's StorageUtil backing. Every StateGlobal read and write is null-guarded; no dedicated mirror global is part of the current manager-owned runtime contract. The older 0499CB Altmer skeleton remains separate and retains PDV_GLO_AltmerCrisis.
waivers.evidence: PDV_StateTrack.psc GetCurrentState, SetState, ResetState, and EnsureStateStorage all implement the StorageUtil fallback; live readback 2026-08-07 confirms the four records remain unbound by design.

waivers.reason: Owner ruling 2026-08-07: Azurah is a native Khajiit deity, so the generic Daedric-path race-rejection response is deliberately absent. Boethiah and Mephala having Khajiit response records does not establish a universal native-pair rule; those culturally distinct shadow readings remain separately authored.
waivers.evidence: PDV_Deity_Azura Stance_Khajiit=0 and the Khajiit roster treats Azurah as native; the deity lane, not the hostile Daedric response lane, owns the relationship.
